roles.create.description: Create a role on the current side (platform or tenant); the code is unique per side and cannot be changed. Requires access.roles.create.
roles.get.description: Get a role with its granted permissions and member count. Requires access.roles.read.
roles.list.description: List roles of the current side with paging, filters, keyword and sorting. Requires access.roles.read.
roles.update.description: Update a role's name, description, order and status. Requires access.roles.update.
roles.delete.description: Delete roles in batch together with their members and permissions; built-in roles cannot be deleted. Requires access.roles.delete.
roles.grant.description: Grant permissions to a role; codes must exist in the catalog and match the role's side. Requires access.roles.grant.
roles.revoke.description: Revoke permissions from a role. Requires access.roles.grant.
roles.assign.description: Assign users to a role; users must belong to the role's side. Takes effect at the user's next token refresh. Requires access.roles.assign.
roles.unassign.description: Remove users from a role. Takes effect at the user's next token refresh. Requires access.roles.assign.
roles.members.description: List the members of a role. Requires access.roles.read.
permissions.list.description: List the grantable permission catalog: the caller's side by default; platform principals may pass side=tenant for the tenant side (used to edit edition whitelists); for tenant principals the catalog is narrowed by their edition. Requires access.permissions.read.
auth.permissions.description: Return the current principal's effective permissions, roles, menu tree and page codes.
access.role.code_taken: Role code '{code}' is already taken on this side.
access.role.built_in: Role '{code}' is built in and cannot be deleted.
access.permission.unknown: Permission '{code}' is not in the catalog.
access.permission.scope_mismatch: Permission '{code}' cannot be granted on the {side} side.
access.member.not_found: User '{id}' does not exist or does not belong to the role's side.
roles.by_user.description: List the roles a user holds on the current side (platform or tenant). Requires access.roles.read.
access.role.data_scope_not_applicable: Platform role '{code}' can only have the data scope 'All' and no custom departments.
access.role.custom_scope_empty: Role '{code}' uses a custom data scope but lists no department.
access.department.not_found: Department '{id}' does not exist in this tenant.
access.permission.side_denied: Tenant principals can only view the tenant-side permission catalog.
